rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something happening very often or repeatedly.
This is a more formal option for repeated or ongoing activity, especially in careful speech and writing.

example.english: The pace of the project is continually accelerating.
example.jyutping: gung1 cing4 zeon3 dou6 bat1 dyun6 gaa1 faai3

rows.note: Use this when an action continues without stopping.

example.english: The phone continually rings without stopping.
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 bat1 ting4 gam3 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this for an action continuing throughout a particular period or alongside another action.

example.english: I continually eat crisps while watching TV.
example.traditional: 我一路睇電視一路食薯片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lou6 tai2 din6 si6 jat1 lou6 sik6 syu4 pin2
